scope: One reusable *priest-specific* silhouette for the 1962 Mass reader's priest genuflection action; not faithful kneeling.
reviewAuthority: User explicitly excluded misleading legacy genuflection and asked for a specific accurate priest pose. Review required before app binding.

artworkRequirements.style: Accurate clean monochrome solid silhouette suitable for currentColor masks, transparent SVG, consistent with approved modern Mass icon family.
artworkRequirements.priest: Roman Rite vested celebrant wearing traditional chasuble, alb and amice silhouette; no modern clerical costume or ordinary congregant proxy.
artworkRequirements.pose: Genuflection: one knee touches ground and the other leg supports the descent. Avoid both knees on floor, which would mean kneeling rather than a genuflection.
artworkRequirements.orientation: Neutral side/three-quarter view with priest's face towards liturgical action; avoid misleading Missal, Gospel book, Host or chalice in icon, since it must be reusable.
artworkRequirements.gestureSemantics: This image shows the priest genuflecting; its precise altar/Gospel direction and timing are always described in event-owned text.
